      FAQsfrequently asked questions

      • Visit the VIPorter webpage to see how the VIPorterV I Porter program works, including its perks and travel benefits. From there, you can also log in to your VIPorterV I Porter account, see your points balance and redeem for flights. 

      • This is the perfect card for people who like collecting VIPorterV I Porter points and flying with Porter! With a BMO VIPorterV I PorterMastercard, you’ll earn points even faster – on every dollar you spend on your card! Plus, the points you earn will never expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.∆∆111 You will also benefit from great perks, like priority boarding, prioritized call centre service and more.

      • To add up to nine (9) authorized users and begin earning VIPorterV I Porter points faster, start by logging into BMO Online Banking.  

        From there, simply select your credit card account, then select Account options and then select Add an authorized user. Alternatively, you can call the number on the back of your card and one of our associates will be happy to add an authorized to your account on your behalf. 

      • If you’re a primary cardholder:  

        To access the card perks to elevate the flying experience for you and up to 8 guests, all you need to do is include the VIPorterV I Porter number that is associated with your BMOVIPorterV I Porter Mastercard on your Porter flight booking.

        If you’re an authorized user:  

        You can still benefit from perks like priority boarding – even if you aren’t travelling with the Primary Cardholder! Simply ask the Primary Cardholder to link your VIPorterV I Porter number to their VIPorterV I Porter account. Once the authorized user account is ready to be linked, Porter will email the Primary Cardholder asking them to start the linking process. Alternatively, once the account is ready to be linked, the Primary Cardholder can follow these steps:  

        1. Log in to your VIPorterV I Porter account 
        2. On your dashboard, select the option to link a new card 
        3. Follow the steps to link your authorized user(s) by entering their VIPorterV I Porter number 

      • The VIPorterV I Porter points that you earn on your credit card will be deposited in your VIPorterV I Porter account on a monthly basis, typically within two business days of your monthly credit card statement being issued.  Statements may not be issued if there's no activity in your account (Purchase, Returns, or Payments) and you have no balance due / account balance when your account cycles. To receive VIPorterV I Porter points, your credit card account also must be open, in good standing and assigned to a VIPorterV I Porter account.

      • How do I know if I am eligible for this card?

        There are a few requirements you need to meet to apply for a credit card with us. 

        • Be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident 
        • Have not declared bankruptcy in the past seven years 
        • Have reached the age of majority in the province in which you live (18 years in ABAlberta, MBManitoba, ONOntario, PEPrince Edward Island, QCQuebec and SKSaskatchewan. 19 years in all other provinces) 
        • Meet any minimum income requirements 

        What information do I need to provide to apply for my card and participate in the VIPorterV I Porter​ program?

        You’ll need to share a few things to participate in the VIPorterV I Porter​ program, including your name, date of birth, email address, telephone number and address. In addition to these details, you’ll also need to share your employment status, income source(s), and rent or mortgage amount to open your credit card account.

        Is my application secure?

        Yes. We’re committed to protecting your confidential information and privacy and we continuously employ the latest security software to our sites and apps. 

        Additionally, our digital experiences have been upgraded with extended validation (EV) SSL Certificates, which add another layer of protection by identifying our sites and applications as legitimate.

        How can I see how many points I earned with my BMO VIPorterV I Porter Mastercard? 

        You can see a breakdown of how many VIPorterV I Porter points you earned each month on your credit card by logging into your VIPorter account or checking out your monthly BMO VIPorterV I Porter credit card statement. 

        Do my VIPorterV I Porter points expire? 

        They don’t! One of the exclusive perks of your BMO VIPorterV I Porter Mastercard account is that as long as it is open and in good standing, your points will not expire. 

        Can I set up a BMO PaySmart installment plan with this card? 

        Yes, you can! You’ll be able to set up, manage and review your PaySmart installment plans from your Online Banking account. 

        To get started, simply login and follow these steps for recent eligible credit card purchases of $100 CADCanadian Dollar or more: 

        1. Choose an eligible credit card purchase you’d like to convert into a PaySmart plan. 
        2. Go to the Installment Plan tab and click the Create button. 
        3. Select the plan that works best for you. 

        What is Avid Traveller? 

        Avid Traveller refers to a group of VIPorter membership levels: Passport, Venture, Ascent and First. To learn more, visit VIPorter.
